assessments.reasoning: The 1,649-byte COPYING at file/file commit b693eed3f033426a8f2bf88e9ef4c51ce64dc929 has the scoped digest. The first line begins with $File: and ends with a space and dollar sign before LF. The comparison retained every subsequent byte.

The complete SPDX detail at the tagged data commit decodes to the exact licenseId and matching licenseText. Its seeAlso points to file/file/blob/master/COPYING. The template and HTML fields played no part in the comparison.

The SPDX repository's GitHub API tag object 76c9a79bb7d2bf851143b76b3935a4d7cbaa644b names v3.29.0. Its target has type commit and SHA 31ba1a50e5397e00a304dbadc76531740e89ee48, matching the Darwin detail locator. The API reports an unsigned tag.

challenge.method: Checked the annotated tag's target type and SHA against the detail URL, inspected seeAlso, tested raw equality, and ran the specified ASCII-in-UTF-8 comparison on the decoded field.
challenge.results: The release target matched. The branch reference supplied no immutable project revision. Raw equality was false. The prescribed comparison returned true for BSD-2-Clause-Darwin after removing only the metadata line and LF.

limitations: The SPDX seeAlso URL names master. The correspondence is confined to the independently pinned file/file commit and SPDX data commit.
SPDX supplies the lookup identifier. Text correspondence establishes neither legal equivalence nor rights in a downstream work.
reasoning: SPDX 3.29.0 identifies BSD-2-Clause-Darwin. Removing the first 56 bytes of the pinned COPYING, comprising the complete $File metadata line and its LF, leaves all 1,593 bytes of the decoded licenseText in order.
